name: CreditCardAccount
description: The credit card account entity. Created by SVC-003 at PH-026 upon an approved application. Central financial entity for the credit card lifecycle: credit limit, available balance, statement cycle, and FCA CONC 6.7.27 persistent debt monitoring state. card_number_token replaces the raw PAN throughout — the full PAN exists only within the PCI CDE managed by the card processing platform.

fields.name: customer_id
fields.validation_rule: Required. FK → Customer.customer_id (ENT-001). Must reference an active Customer. Immutable.

fields.name: card_number_token
fields.validation_rule: Required. Format-preserving token from the PCI-compliant tokenisation vault. Never the raw PAN. Immutable (new token generated on card replacement).
fields.pci_note: PCI DSS v4.0 Req 3.5 — PAN must be protected. card_number_token is the only form stored and transmitted outside the PCI CDE.

fields.name: credit_limit
fields.validation_rule: Required. GBP. Min £250.00, max £50,000.00. Set from ENT-022.assigned_credit_limit.

fields.name: available_balance
fields.validation_rule: Required. credit_limit minus current outstanding balance. Must never go negative. Updated atomically on each authorised transaction.

fields.name: statement_balance
fields.validation_rule: Required. Closing balance at last statement date. Null before first statement.

fields.name: minimum_payment
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. Minimum payment due from last statement. Must cover all interest + fees + minimum principal (CONC 7.7). Null before first statement.

fields.name: apr
fields.validation_rule: Required. Annual Percentage Rate as percentage (e.g. 24.9). CCA 1974 Schedule 5 true APR.

fields.name: status
fields.validation_rule: Required. Enum: issued | active | suspended | closed. issued → active on card activation; active → suspended on persistent debt 36-month trigger; active | suspended → closed on account closure.

fields.name: persistent_debt_flag
fields.validation_rule: Required. Default: false. Set to true when persistent_debt_months reaches 18 (FCA CONC 6.7.27).

fields.name: persistent_debt_months
fields.validation_rule: Required. Non-negative integer. Rolling count of months paying more in interest/charges than principal. Resets to 0 when principal repayment exceeds interest/charges.

fields.name: opened_date
fields.validation_rule: Required. ISO 8601. Date the account was created (PH-026). Immutable.

fields.name: statement_date_day
fields.validation_rule: Required. Day of month (1–28) on which the monthly statement cycle closes.

relationships.description: CreditCardAccount belongs to one Customer via customer_id FK.
CreditCardAccount was created from one approved CreditCardApplication.
CreditCardAccount generates one StatementCycle per monthly billing period.

design_decisions.decision: card_number_token is the only card identifier stored on CreditCardAccount. Raw PAN is not stored in SVC-003.
design_decisions.rationale: PCI DSS v4.0 Req 3.5. Tokenisation via the card processing platform means SVC-003 is minimally scoped for PCI CDE, materially reducing certification cost.

design_decisions.decision: persistent_debt_months is a stored rolling counter, not derived from the transaction ledger at query time.
design_decisions.rationale: FCA CONC 6.7.27 requires proactive identification. A stored counter enables event-driven alerting (EVT-048) at precise 18/27/36 month thresholds without a full ledger scan.

design_decisions.decision: available_balance is a cached field updated atomically on each transaction, not computed from the ledger.
design_decisions.rationale: Card authorisation (JRN-011) requires sub-second latency. Real-time ledger aggregation would not meet Visa/Mastercard SLA.

new_relationships.description: CreditCardAccount is the account against which CardAuthorisation (credit card) transactions are authorised. Relationship via account_id FK on ENT-032. JRN-011 is the primary journey that exercises CreditCardAccount.available_balance (DD-ENT023-03) as the balance source for real-time card authorisation decisions in SVC-011's local cache.

design_decisions_activated: DD-ENT023-03 — available_balance is a cached field updated on each transaction. JRN-011 PH-044 is the update mechanism: SVC-003 consumes EVT-065 (CardAuthorisationCompleted) to decrement available_balance for balance reservations, and EVT-067 (CardSettlementProcessed) to post the final settlement.
